zh.title: 衣索比亞航空停飛北部三城航班
zh.summary: 衣索比亞航空停飛北境三城航班
body: 埃塞俄比亞航空（Ethiopian Airlines）於2026年9月23日暫停飛往衣索比亞北部三個城市的航班。
該公司表示，停飛原因是「提格雷地區當前情勢」，涉及城市包括Mekelle、Axum和Shire。
地方消息來源告訴路透社（Reuters），提格雷部隊已於夜間從聯邦警察手中接管Mekelle機場。
美聯社（Associated Press）引述當地一名計程車司機說法，提格雷人民解放陣線（TPLF）戰鬥人員要求他離開，並稱不會有航班降落。該司機表示未聽到槍聲。
埃塞俄比亞航空向受影響旅客致歉，並表示會在航班恢復時通知其。根據AeroTime報導，該公司是唯一營運飛往提格雷航班的航空公司。

en.title: Ethiopian Airlines suspends flights to three cities as forces seize Mekelle Airport
en.summary: Ethiopian Airlines suspends flights after Mekelle Airport seized
body: Ethiopian Airlines suspended flights to three cities in northern Ethiopia on September 23, 2026, after Tigrayan forces seized Mekelle Airport amid renewed fighting between regional and federal forces.
The state-owned airline halted services to Mekelle, Axum and Shire, citing the current situation in the Tigray region.
Local sources told Reuters that Tigrayan forces had taken control of the airport in Mekelle from federal police overnight.

A taxi driver at Mekelle airport told The Associated Press that fighters from the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) were carrying light weapons and ordered him to leave. He reported hearing no gunfire during the takeover.
Ethiopian Airlines apologized to affected customers and said it would notify them when flights resume. Ethiopian is the only airline operating scheduled flights to Tigray.
